reason: I use AI at work all day, but I don't let it near my money. I already put money into index funds every payday in my broker app without any help, and a cartoon pet doing it for me doesn't make it feel any safer.
objection: I'd be handing my real money to an AI agent at a company that doesn't even have a broker partner yet, and the Tamagotchi makes it feel like a game, not like something I'd trust with my savings.
would_change_my_mind: A long, public, audited track record with real money through a licensed broker I already know, where the agent only suggests and nothing moves unless I tap to approve each trade.
